findings.label: No-ID and stale-state Join flow
findings.finding: /sessions calls fetchSession(undefined) and hides the form while that invalid request loads; a failed lookup with stale currentSession shows the error inside the form and suppresses the below-form panel.
findings.action: Skip lookup without an ID and track lookup failure independently from prior session state.

findings.label: Dashboard overlay position
findings.finding: Dashboard retains a center-right title and subtitle even though only hero height is exempted.
findings.action: Apply the required bottom-left 24px overlay or obtain an explicit product exception.

findings.label: Duplicated New Campaign styling
findings.finding: HomeView and CampaignsView contain matching scoped button and label rules that can drift.
findings.action: Move the shared visual contract into a reusable class or component.

findings.label: Join regression coverage
findings.finding: No view-level test or browser check covers /sessions without an ID, stale Pinia session state, or final form/QR/error ordering.
findings.action: Add focused coverage after correcting the flow.
